items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: that was Bagby playing that clarinet

ctx.x: So it might be Herschel or it might be Scott.

Yeah, at the beginning of the solo, to remind me of Herschel, but I have always been in doubt that Herschel was in the band. He possibly was just coming in there, but that was Bagby playing that clarinet.
Oh, so you may have had Scott got back. You may have had four saxes.
